SUMMARY: SinkFactory builds a procedural kitchen/bathroom sink (a filleted basin carved into a counter top-slice with a drain hole) plus a paired water TapFactory faucet, both assigned random metal materials with optional scratch/edge-wear. The sink geometry, drain, and the cutter used to carve the counter are generated by `nodegroup_sink_geometry`; the faucet (spout, handles, base) is generated by `nodegroup_water_tap`+`nodegroup_handle`. The upper-level file exposes all shape parameters, material sampling, and node-graph constants; note this factory produces a sink, not the requested oyster/pearl.

EDITABLE (upper-level files — change these to alter the result):

FILE: assets/objects/table_decorations/__init__.py
  module exports: re-exports SinkFactory, TapFactory (and book/vase factories); edit to expose/rename factories.

FILE: assets/objects/table_decorations/sink.py

  SinkFactory.__init__: assembles sink; owns params + material + a TapFactory instance.
    knobs: dimensions([1,1,1] passed in) -> overall placeholder scale reference; upper_height(None->sampled) -> basin depth override.

  SinkFactory.sample_parameters (all randomly sampled per seed):
    knobs: Width(U 0.4-1.0) -> basin left-right size; Depth(U 0.4-0.5) -> basin front-back size; Curvature(U 1.0-1.0, fixed=1) -> horizontal scaling/bulge of basin walls; Upper Height(U 0.2-0.4) -> basin wall height / tap Z; Lower Height(U 0.00-0.01) -> floor/rim thickness of basin bottom; HoleRadius(U 0.02-0.05) -> drain hole radius; Margin(U 0.02-0.05) -> counter rim width around basin; WaterTapMargin(U 0.1-0.12) -> extra depth behind basin for tap deck + tap X offset; ProtrudeAboveCounter(U 0.01-0.025) -> thickness of top slice placeholder above counter.

  SinkFactory.get_material_params: samples Sink & Tap metal materials.
    knobs: Sink/Tap = weighted_sample(material_assignments.metals) (random metal); scratch/edge_wear gated by material_assignments.wear_tear_prob (random on/off). NOTE finalize_assets currently no-ops (scratch/edge_wear application commented out).

  SinkFactory.create_asset: spawns sink, parents cutter (hidden, carves counter) and tap.
    knobs: tap_loc = (-Depth/2, 0, Upper Height) -> faucet placement.

  SinkFactory.create_placeholder: builds bbox top-slice from geometry using ProtrudeAboveCounter.

  TapFactory.tap_parameters (all randomly sampled): faucet shape switches/sizes.
    knobs: base_width(U 0.570-0.630) -> faucet base plate width; tap_head(U 0.7-1.1) -> spout head Z scale; roation_z(U 5.5-7.0) -> spout Z rotation; tap_height(U 0.5-1) -> spout Z scale; base_radius(U 0.0-0.3) -> base plate corner fillet; Switch(bool 50%) -> spout style A/B; Y(U -0.5 to -0.06) -> spout bezier handle control; hand_type(bool 80% true) -> lever vs cross handle style; hands_length_x(U 0.750-1.25)/hands_length_Y(U 0.950-1.550) -> handle dimensions; one_side(bool 50%) -> single vs double handle; different_type(bool 20% true) -> alternate whole-faucet style.
    NOTE tap_parameters() defined but create_asset actually uses self.params from get_material_params (only "Tap" material socket + graph defaults) — edit get_material_params/create_asset to feed tap_parameters through.

  TapFactory.create_asset: applies nodegroup_water_tap to a cube.
    knobs: obj.scale(0.4) -> overall faucet size; rotation_euler.z += pi -> faucet facing.

  nodegroup_handle (GeometryNodeTree): faucet handle bezier profile.
    knobs: bezier Start/Handle/End points -> handle curve shape; FloatCurve radius (0.975->0.1625) -> taper; multiply 1.3 -> thickness; CurveCircle Radius 0.2 -> tube radius; SubdivisionSurface Level 2 -> smoothness.

  nodegroup_water_tap (GeometryNodeTree): full faucet mesh (spout, handles, base). Constants are hard-coded fixed values inside graph:
    knobs: spout curve_line End (0,0,0.6) & transform scale (5.2,0.5,7.8) -> spout arc; curve_circle radii 0.03/0.05/0.1 -> tube thicknesses; cylinder handle Radius 0.03/0.005, Depth 0.1 -> handle knobs; quadrilateral Width base_width/Height 0.7 + fillet Radius base_radius -> base plate; SetMaterial uses "Tap" input.

  nodegroup_sink_geometry (GeometryNodeTree): outputs "Geometry" (sink) and "Cutter" (counter hole tool). Key fixed constants:
    knobs: interior fillet Count 50 & Radius = min(Depth,Width)*0.1 -> basin corner roundness; transform Scale 0.99 -> rim wall thickness; drain: curve_circle scale (0.7,0.7,1) -> drain inner ring; deck quadrilateral built from Depth+WaterTapMargin & Width+Margin with fillet -> counter deck outline; Curvature multiply on X/Y for Z<0 verts -> basin taper; cutter fillet Count 3, Scale (1.01,1.01,1), extrude = Lower+Upper+0.05 -> counter carve volume; SetMaterial uses "Sink" input.

  geometry_node_to_bbox: helper bounding-box shrink (Scale 0.1); unused utility.

LINKED TO INFINIGEN (infra — do NOT edit, resolved from the original package):
  assets/composition/material_assignments.py -> metals list + wear_tear/wear_tear_prob material pools used for Sink/Tap.
  assets/materials/metal/__init__.py -> actual metal shader generators sampled.
  assets/materials/wear_tear/scratches.py, edge_wear.py -> optional surface wear materials.
  assets/utils/extract_nodegroup_parts.py -> extract_nodegroup_geo: bakes a nodegroup output socket into a mesh object.
  assets/utils/bbox_from_mesh.py -> box_from_corners for placeholder generation.
  core/nodes/node_wrangler.py, node_utils.py, node_info.py -> node graph construction, Nodes enum, to_nodegroup decorator.
  core/placement/factory.py -> AssetFactory base (spawn_asset/placeholder lifecycle).
  core/placement/detail.py -> level-of-detail optimization.
  core/tagging.py, core/tags.py -> semantic tagging of generated geometry.
  core/util/blender.py -> spawn/modify/delete/bounds/TemporaryObject mesh helpers.
  core/util/math.py -> FixedSeed deterministic sampling.
  core/util/random.py -> weighted_sample for material choice.
  core/util/color.py -> color/HSV utilities (metal color, currently TODO).
  core/surface.py -> material application to objects.
  Other listed materials/*, core/* -> shared material libraries and engine plumbing, not sink-specific.
